added.title: Sports Digital Group Product Lead - Innovation_Delivery_Transformation
added.description:
The Team

ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics. Cross-functional product teams turn market needs into scalable products and repeatable decision workflows rather than one-off solutions.

This role leads the digital product group, which owns the fan-facing digital portfolio across mobile, web, streaming, personalization, and merchandising experiences. The group brings together content, identity, engagement, personalization, notifications, and commercial experiences, and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases.

Position Summary

Are you a digital product leader who has built and scaled fan-facing experiences across mobile, web, and streaming for major sports and media brands? ConvergeSPORTS is assembling a senior product group to take its digital portfolio to market, and this role leads it. If you want ownership of a portfolio rather than a single feature set, we would like to talk with you.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As the Digital Group Product Lead, you will own the vision, roadmap, and commercial outcomes for the ConvergeSPORTS fan-facing digital portfolio, spanning mobile, web, streaming, personalization, and merchandising. Your work will include:

Own the multi-product vision, roadmap, release strategy, and outcome metrics for the digital product group.
Set product priorities across mobile, web, streaming, personalization, and merchandising experiences, and resolve tradeoffs between them.
Lead and develop product managers within the group, establishing product standards, review cadence, and decision rights.
Conduct fan, client, and market discovery to define user problems, journeys, and commercial opportunities across the portfolio.
Partner with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, and Design to sequence work and align roadmap with platform capability.
Define required identity, event data, content, notification, and personalization capabilities with Engineering and Data partners.
Balance individual client needs against reusable architecture, shared components, and portfolio scalability.
Track adoption, engagement, retention, experience quality, and commercial performance across digital products.
Lead release readiness, App Store and Play Store coordination, and post-launch evaluation for group products.
Develop product narratives, demo flows, sales enablement materials, and executive roadmap communications.
Define AI-native and agentic fan experiences using trusted data, clear permissions, evaluation criteria, and human review points.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

Portfolio-level product judgment, with the ability to sequence competing product bets against business outcomes.
Ability to connect fan needs, sports and media business outcomes, and platform capability into a coherent strategy.
Credibility with engineers and designers, and comfort operating close to technical detail without taking over delivery.
Ability to develop other product managers and raise the standard of product thinking across a group.
Clear executive communication, including the ability to make a recommendation and own the decision.
Collaborative influence across matrixed teams without relying on direct authority.

Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
10+ years of experience in product management or digital product leadership.
5+ years of experience owning consumer-facing digital products across two or more of the following: native mobile, web, streaming or OTT, personalization, or e-commerce and merchandising.
3+ years of experience leading or managing product managers.
2+ years of experience using Agile product tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or Confluence.
Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

Experience in sports, media, or entertainment organizations.
Experience launching a native mobile application from concept through public release.
Hands-on SQL or BI tool experience to define and validate product metrics.
Experience with experimentation and A/B testing programs.
Graduate degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500-$265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

added.title: Head of Academic Partners & Programs, Fauna Robotics
added.description:
Description

Fauna Robotics is building the future of personal robotics — and we want it to be the best platform for researchers and developers to build on. We’re looking for a leader to build and scale our academic segment: the programs, partnerships, and mechanisms that put Fauna robots into the hands of the world’s top robotics researchers and turn them into a thriving, self-reinforcing community.

You'll own the strategy, the relationships, and the sales channel end-to-end — from a researcher's first pilot to institution-wide adoption. You will own how labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets. You'll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers' hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You'll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform.

You will be Fauna’s primary point of engagement with the robotics research community. You’ll own the strategy and the relationships end-to-end — from qualifying a priority lab to scaling adoption across an entire institution. You’ll design the grant and phased-access programs that put robots in researchers’ hands, and run the pilots that prove them out. You’ll represent Fauna where researchers gather — ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI — and cultivate a community of people building on our platform. And you’ll own the sales channel for the segment — the paths by which labs evaluate, acquire, and expand their Fauna fleets.

Just as importantly, you’ll be the bridge between that community and our product org — translating what researchers discover into a clearer roadmap, better robots, and a stronger talent pipeline. This is a role for someone who works shoulder-to-shoulder with scientists and AI researchers, knows the rhythms of academic life, and wants to build the definitive research robotics platform with them.

This role owns the research/academic segment end-to-end as its relationship, program, sales, and customer-success lead. You’ll work hand-in-hand with partner functions — product, fleet operations & logistics, data/telemetry engineering, and our broader ecosystem team — who own the shared infrastructure, so you can stay focused on strategy, relationships, and impact.

Key job responsibilities

Segment Strategy & Sales

Own the strategy for Fauna’s academic segment: map and prioritize target institutions and labs, define what makes Fauna the platform of choice for researchers, and set the adoption plan.
Manage our pipeline of funded labs, principal investigators, and technical champions — qualifying opportunities on research value, funding path, influence, and expansion potential.
Own the sales channel for the research segment — the paths by which labs and institutions acquire, deploy, and grow their Fauna fleets, always grounded in research fit.
Partner with fleet operations, finance, and legal to structure the grant, sponsored-research, pricing, and purchase options that fit how universities actually buy.
Build repeatable paths and clean handoffs from an individual researcher to lab- and institution-wide adoption.
Serve as the connection between Amazon-internal research and academic teams and Fauna product/engineering, coordinating with Amazon Robotics and Amazon Science on shared interests.

University Partnerships & Grants

Own the university grant program end-to-end: application, evaluation, awarding, and reporting.
Design and operate the access mechanisms that get robots into researchers’ hands — grant, phased-access, and fellows-style programs, including eligibility, selection, onboarding, and program goals.
Run pilots end-to-end; remove trust, funding, and technical blockers; drive real activation, retention, and expansion.
Partner with Fauna Science and Scholars on program design and relationships with target universities.
Support the Fauna intern program, linking academic partnerships to the talent pipeline.

External Engagement & Community

Represent Fauna at key conferences (ICRA, RSS, CoRL, IROS, HRI) — sponsorships, workshops, talks, and demos.
Convene and manage a Research Advisory Board to guide program design and the hardware/software roadmaps.
Amplify state-of-the-art partner research and results on Fauna robots, in partnership with our marketing team.

Research Experience & Product Feedback

Own the researcher relationship and experience for the university/research fleet — onboarding, enablement, and satisfaction.
Partner with product and leadership to define what we want out of research: which capabilities it pressure-tests, what feedback should shape the hardware and software roadmaps, and how it strengthens Fauna.
Translate community requirements into prioritized input for product and engineering.
Turn early usage into product feedback, case studies, peer proof, and repeatable enablement.
Partner with fleet operations and data/telemetry teams to keep researchers productive and their robots healthy.

Metrics & Reporting

Define the program’s KPIs — robots deployed and utilization, researcher activation / retention / expansion, researcher NPS, publications on Fauna robots, community engagement, and grant pipeline health — and use them to inform strategy and leadership reviews.

About The Team

Fauna Robotics, an Amazon company, is building capable, safe, and genuinely delightful robots for everyday life. Our goal is simple: make robots people actually want to live and interact with in everyday human spaces.

We believe that future won’t arrive until building for robotics becomes far more accessible. Today, too much effort is spent reinventing the fundamentals. We’re changing that by developing tightly integrated hardware and software systems that make it faster, safer, and more intuitive to create real-world robotic products.

Our work spans the full stack: mechanical design, control systems, dynamic modeling, and intelligent software. The focus is not just functionality, but experience. We’re building robots that feel responsive, expressive, and genuinely useful.

At Fauna, you’ll work at the frontier of this space, helping define how robots move, manipulate, and interact with people in natural environments. It’s an opportunity to solve hard problems across hardware and software with a team focused on making robotics accessible and joyful to build.

If you care about making robotics real for everyone and building systems that are as delightful as they are capable, we’re interested in hearing from you.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of developing, negotiating and executing business agreements experience
7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, robotics, or a related field.
8+ years in program management, business development, partnerships, or research/developer relations.
History of working tightly with scientists, AI researchers, and academic institutions — and fluency in academic motions (conferences, labs, grant and sponsored-research cycles).
Experience navigating complex institutions — researchers, research IT, procurement, funders, and administrators.

Preferred Qualifications

PhD or funded-lab research experience; established credibility with R1 researchers.
Experience managing university grant or sponsored-research programs.
Consultative or technical sales experience selling into higher-education or research institutions, including their procurement and funding cycles.
Advanced degree (MS or PhD) in robotics, AI, engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience in robotics or with robotic systems.
Experience with sales, channel, or go-to-market motion — bringing a new product to new customers and growing adoption through direct and partner-led paths.
Experience building developer/research communities or programs.
Product experience — comfortable translating user needs into roadmap input.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. added.title: Principal Technical Program Manager - Prime Video, PV Personalization and Discovery
added.description:
Description

Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video add-on subscriptions such as Apple TV+, Max, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience.

As a Prime Video technologist, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is on a mission to reimagine how customers discover and engage with content across the entertainment landscape. As part of this vision, we’re investing heavily in building scalable, science-friendly infrastructure to accelerate the pace of innovation in machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). We’re seeking a Principal Engineer to lead the technical direction of our next-generation Recommender Systems (RecSys) platforms — systems that sit at the core of how customers experience Prime Video.

About The Team

Prime Video Personalization and Discovery (PVPD) is dedicated to creating a highly personalized content discovery experience that not only delights our customers but also drives both short-and long-term business goals. Our scope includes personalized recommendations, search, marketing, and the advanced machine learning technology and infrastructure that underpins these experiences. Our mission is to automate and enhance customer engagement through personalization, using ML and Generative AI.

Key Job Responsibilities

In this role, you will partner closely with applied scientists, product teams, and platform engineers to define and deliver highly extensible systems that fuel personalized discovery at scale. you will lead the technical strategy and architecture of Prime Video’s end-to-end personalization stack — spanning data ingestion, feature engineering, training and serving platform, candidate retrieval, multi-stage ranking, dynamic content grouping, whole page optimization, and orchestration. Your work will shape how millions of customers discover content they love, optimizing for engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.

You will bring clarity to ambiguity, complexity, ROI, planning, and trade-off etc that dramatically improves the agility, usability, and extensibility of our ML solutions. Your technical leadership will shape the future of AI/ML across Prime Video, unlocking generative and ML models that personalize content for hundreds of millions of viewers worldwide.

Key job responsibilities

Consistently meet challenging deadlines and deliver high-quality solutions that enable the Prime Video platform to scale to meet growing customer demand.
Overcome obstacles and persist in the face of setbacks to ensure critical initiatives are successfully completed.
Proactively identify and mitigate risks, communicating regularly with stakeholders on project status and issues.
Demonstrate deep technical expertise in cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, ML/AI fluency and large-scale data processing.
Understand the architecture and design limitations of the existing Prime Video systems, ML models, and drive technical decisions that address deficiencies and optimize performance.
Use data-driven analysis to make a compelling case for project priorities and resource allocation.
Accountable for the overall strategy and successful execution of large, complex infrastructure optimization and scaling programs.
Partner closely with engineering, product, and business leaders to align initiatives with high-level objectives and achieve measurable improvements in efficiency or customer experience.
Communicate ideas effectively to a wide range of audiences, foster constructive dialogue, and lead the resolution of contentious technical issues.
Set a best-in-class example for project/program management practices, driving crisp decision-making and proactive risk mitigation.

Basic Qualifications

7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
7+ years of technical product or program management experience
5+ years of software development experience
Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

Preferred Qualifications

8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

added.title: Senior Product Manager, External Services - Fraud Enforcement, AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention
added.description:
Description

Want to define how AWS responds when fraud or account compromise is detected? Join the AWS Payments & Fraud Prevention team as a Senior Product Manager - External Services, where you will own the product strategy for real-time fraud enforcement across AWS.

AWS Fraud Prevention uses identity, account activity, payment, and service usage signals in machine learning models and AI systems to detect fraud and account compromise. This role will define how AWS turns those risk assessments into fast, consistent enforcement actions that protect customers and AWS across services and regions. You will own the strategy and roadmap for real-time enforcement, including reusable capabilities, customer safeguards, service adoption, and measures of speed and accuracy.

The ideal candidate has a strong track record of defining and delivering technical products at scale. You understand distributed systems, automated decision-making, and how to balance rapid fraud prevention with the impact on legitimate customers. You can also align teams across AWS around a common product strategy and technical approach.

Key job responsibilities

Real-Time Enforcement Strategy: Own the vision and roadmap for how AWS turns risk assessments into consistent enforcement actions. Define reusable capabilities that help mitigate fraud across all AWS services without building a separate solution for each use case.

Reliable Execution: Define product and technical requirements for enforcement actions that must complete in real-time. Partner with Engineering to ensure enforcement is scalable, observable, and resilient across services and regions.

Policy and Customer Safeguards: Define how the severity and confidence of a risk assessment, customer context, and potential impact determine the appropriate response. Establish requirements for actions, customer communication, auditability, human review when needed, and paths to recovery.

AWS Service Adoption: Expand real-time enforcement across AWS compute, AI, Marketplace, and emerging products. Identify coverage gaps, prioritize integrations, and make enforcement readiness part of product launch planning.

Measurement and Improvement:Track time to action, execution success, automation coverage, false positives, customer recovery, and prevented fraud loss.

Cross-Functional Leadership:Partner with AWS service teams, Identity, Security, Customer Service, Engineering, Science, Legal, and product leaders. Align teams on priorities, resolve trade-offs between fraud prevention and customer experience, and represent the domain in executive reviews.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product management with internet business experience
Experience in taking a product from conception & definition phase through engineering design and taking it to market
Experience driving direction and alignment with cross-functional teams
Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
Experience using AI tools to accelerate product development, research, and decision-making

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with engineering and technical teams to build automated solutions
Experience in fraud prevention, trust and safety, security operations, or account-risk products
Experience with cloud services, resource management, account security, or access controls

added.title: Head of Product Management - Unica
added.description:
About the job

About the product

Unica+ is HCL Software’s enterprise marketing platform. It covers campaign management, journey orchestration, real-time interaction management, a customer data platform and a customer data model layer. An AI agent layer runs across the
modules.
Customers are in North America, Europe, India and Asia Pacific. Most are large enterprises. The base is heavily BFSI and telecom. A significant number run on-premise or in a sovereign cloud, not public SaaS. This affects almost every roadmap decision.

About the role

We need a product leader to own the Unica+ roadmap and run the product management team.
The person in this role decides what gets built and what does not. They set release strategy. They own how we are positioned against competitors at the top end, and against regional CDP vendors who compete on price.

The product is shifting towards AI-assisted marketing operations and governed customer data. At the same time we have a large installed base with commitments that must be honoured. Both sit on the same roadmap.

Key responsibilities:

Own the multi-release roadmap across all Unica+ modules. Sequence it against revenue, renewal risk and competitive exposure.
Build the business case for major investments and take it to senior leadership. This includes sizing at-risk or blocked revenue.
Set direction for the AI agent capabilities. Scope, evaluation approach, guardrails, cost to serve.
Own product requirements coming out of data residency and privacy regulation. GDPR and the EU AI Act, US state privacy laws, India’s DPDP Act and RBI localisation directives, and equivalent regimes in APAC. Deployment options must keep pace with what regulated buyers need in each market.
Work with the decisioning and data governance initiatives elsewhere in the portfolio. Lineage, consent and governance should be handled once, not module by module.
Partner with product marketing, sales and pre-sales on launch material, competitive positioning and enablement.
Drive internal adoption of each release with regional sales leadership.
Run a customer advisory programme with the top accounts.
Engage directly on escalations where a product decision is the root cause.
Represent the product with industry analysts. Briefings, enquiries, evaluation submissions.
Hire, lead and develop a product management team spread across regions and time zones. Module PMs, technical PMs, product operations.
Work with engineering leadership on release planning, quality and technical debt.

Requirements:

12+ years in product management. 5+ years managing product managers.
Ownership of an enterprise B2B product with a large installed base.
Depth in at least two of: campaign management, CDP, real-time decisioning, journey orchestration, marketing automation.
Experience shipping across on-premise, private cloud and SaaS in the same product line.
Track record of competing against larger vendors.
Ability to build a business case and defend it commercially.
Strong written communication. Most of this job is documents that other people act on.
Bachelor’s degree required. MBA or equivalent is useful, not mandatory.

Good to have:

BFSI, telecom or public sector experience in more than one region.
Production experience with LLM or agentic features in an enterprise product.
Analyst relations, including Magic Quadrant or Wave submissions.
Familiarity with data catalog, lineage and governance tooling.
Displacement selling against an incumbent marketing cloud.
Experience running a product function across time zones.

About HCL Software

HCL Software is the software business of HCLTech. Products span digital experience, data, automation and security. The eXperience portfolio includes Unica+ along with Commerce, Digital Experience and Volt MX.

added.description:

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Slack & The Role

Slack is at an inflection point. We're evolving from the world's most beloved team communication tool into an AI operating system for work, where humans and agents get things done together. The developer platform is how that future comes to life: it's the ecosystem that lets builders at every scale extend Slack with agents and apps, creating them, managing them, and distributing them through the Slack Marketplace.

As Senior Director, Product Design - Ecosystem, you'll hold and continuously refine the design vision for the developer experience across Slack's platform, partnering closely with product and engineering leadership. This is a player-coach role: you'll build and grow a small team of designers while staying hands-on in the design work yourself. You'll report to the Vice President, Product Design.

The Opportunity: Defining How the World Builds on Slack

You'll own design across the platform's full arc: what agents do inside Slack, how they're built, how they're managed and discovered, and how partners bring theirs to the ecosystem. As AI redefines both how software gets built and how work gets done, you'll shape what that developer experience becomes. The open questions you'll answer:

The Agent Experience: What should agents do inside Slack, and how do people build them now that AI has changed what "building" means?
Management: How do developers and admins run a growing ecosystem of agents with confidence?
Discovery: How do people find and trust the right agents in the marketplace?
Partners: How do we host partners like OpenAI, Anthropic, Cognition, and GitHub so their agents feel native to Slack?

Key Responsibilities

Design Vision: Hold and continuously refine the long-range design vision for the platform, in close partnership with product and engineering leadership
End-to-End Platform Design: Drive design across the full developer lifecycle: defining what agents do in Slack, agent creation, install and management, and marketplace discovery
Partner Experience: Shape how partners building on Slack (OpenAI, Anthropic, Cognition, GitHub, and more) bring their agents into the ecosystem
Hands-On Craft: Contribute directly to the design work as a player-coach, setting the craft bar for the team
Team Leadership: Grow and develop the platform design team, owning staffing and career development for the designers on it

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of product design experience, including work on developer-facing or highly technical products
Experience managing and growing design teams
Hands-on experience with AI and vibe-coding tools, and a solid understanding of developer workflows
A track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership to define and refine product direction through design

Preferred Qualifications

Experience designing marketplace or agent-discovery experiences
Experience bringing third-party agentic experiences into a product
Experience designing multiplayer or collaborative use cases
Deep familiarity with Slack's platform surfaces and how its ecosystem works

What Makes This Role Different

This role combines the altitude of owning a platform's design vision with the hands-on latitude of a builder. You'll shape how developers build on Slack in an era where the nature of "building" itself is changing, and you'll grow the team doing that work.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

added.title: Director - Product Support
added.description:
Company Profile

With over 80 years of innovation, JCB is the world’s largest privately owned manufacturer of construction and agricultural equipment. Operating 23 manufacturing facilities across four continents—including the United States, the United Kingdom, India, and Brazil—JCB produces a diverse portfolio of more than 300 products. These include telescopic handlers, backhoe loaders, excavators, wheel loaders, compact excavators, skid steer loaders, compact track loaders, access aerial work platforms, rough terrain forklifts, and tractors.

At the heart of JCB’s success are its people. As a family-owned business, we are accountable to our customers—not shareholders—which gives us the flexibility to focus on long-term innovation and delivering real value. This independence allows us to continuously develop advanced technologies and integrate them into equipment designed to perform in the toughest environments while maximizing customer productivity.

At JCB, we stand behind our products—and our name—with pride and commitment to quality.

Position Purpose

The Director of Customer & Product Support is responsible for developing and executing JCB North America’s customer support, parts, and service strategy for Dealer Sales customers. This position provides strategic and operational leadership to ensure customers and dealers receive responsive, consistent, and commercially effective product support throughout the equipment lifecycle.

The Director will lead a team of product support professionals, strengthen dealer service capabilities, increase parts and service revenue, improve equipment uptime, and drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction. This leader will partner closely with JCB dealers, customers, Sales, Parts, Service, Warranty, Training, and other internal stakeholders to identify market opportunities, resolve complex customer concerns, and improve the overall ownership experience.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of construction equipment with commercial leadership, dealer development, business planning, and customer relationship management.

Position Type

Full Time, Exempt

Location

Texas with 50% travel required.

Benefits And Other Compensation

JCB offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; 401 (k) retirement plan; paid time off and paid holidays.

Application Process

Applications will be accepted through Careers | JCB Careers | JCB Jobs | JCB or via LinkedIn. The anticipated application window will close on October 30, 2026.

Major Tasks, Responsibilities & Key Accountabilities

Strategic Leadership

Develop and execute the customer and product support strategy for JCB North America’s Dealer Sales business.
Translate organizational objectives into measurable parts, service, customer satisfaction, and dealer performance plans.
Establish annual and long-range priorities that support revenue growth, profitability, equipment uptime, dealer capability, and customer retention.
Serve as a senior product support leader and trusted advisor to JCB dealers, key customers, and internal business partners.
Provide executive leadership with clear reporting on business performance, customer trends, operational risks, and improvement opportunities.

Team Leadership & Development

Recruit, lead, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing team of product support managers and technicians.
Establish clear expectations, performance standards, development plans, and accountability across the product support organization.
Build a culture centered on urgency, technical excellence, collaboration, customer focus, and continuous improvement.
Evaluate team capacity, geographic coverage, technical capabilities, and training needs to ensure effective support for the dealer network.
Create succession and talent development plans that strengthen the long-term capabilities of the Product Support organization.

Commercial & Financial Performance

Own the achievement of quarterly and annual parts and service revenue, profitability, and customer support objectives.
Identify and execute business development opportunities that increase parts penetration, service activity, customer retention, and lifecycle value.
Lead forecasting, budgeting, and performance reporting for assigned parts and service activities.
Use profit and loss statements, return on investment, absorption rates, market penetration, equipment population, and other business metrics to guide decisions.
Partner with dealers to develop actionable plans that improve service absorption, parts availability, technician productivity, and overall profitability.
Evaluate commercial programs and customer support initiatives to ensure they deliver measurable business value.

Dealer Development & Performance

Build strong, trusted relationships with dealer principals, senior leaders, service managers, parts managers, and key customer decision-makers.
Assess dealer product support capabilities and develop improvement plans addressing staffing, training, tooling, facilities, parts availability, service responsiveness, and customer coverage.
Establish and monitor dealer performance indicators related to parts, service, warranty, customer satisfaction, and equipment uptime.
Identify market opportunities and provide dealers with the data, tools, and direction needed to capture additional parts and service business.
Support the implementation of consistent product support standards across the dealer network.
Lead business reviews with dealers to evaluate results, identify risks, establish commitments, and monitor corrective actions.

Customer Experience & Equipment Uptime

Champion a customer-first approach that improves satisfaction, loyalty, and confidence in JCB products and support.
Increase equipment uptime and availability across the Dealer Sales customer base by improving response times, technical resolution, parts support, and dealer service capability.
Provide senior-level leadership for complex or escalated technical and customer concerns.
Identify recurring product, service, and support issues and coordinate cross-functional corrective actions.
Establish processes for gathering, analyzing, and acting on dealer and customer feedback.
Ensure customer concerns are addressed with urgency, professionalism, clear communication, and appropriate follow-through.

Product & Technical Support

Maintain a strong working knowledge of JCB products, applications, systems, and service requirements.
Ensure field teams and dealers receive the technical information, training, tools, and support required to effectively service JCB equipment.
Partner with Technical Service, Training, Warranty, Quality, Engineering, Parts, and Product teams to address field issues and improve product performance.
Analyze field-service data, warranty trends, equipment performance, and customer feedback to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
Support new product introductions by ensuring dealers and internal teams are prepared to provide effective parts, service, and technical support.

Performance Management & Reporting

Forecast, track, analyze, and report parts, service, dealer, and customer support performance to senior leadership.
Establish dashboards and key performance indicators that provide visibility into business performance and areas requiring action.
Use data to evaluate market coverage, customer penetration, equipment uptime, service responsiveness, dealer capability, and commercial performance.
Develop corrective action plans when performance falls below expectations and ensure actions are completed.
Maintain accurate, timely, and actionable reporting for leadership and key business stakeholders.
Other duties as assigned

Key Performance Indicators

Parts and service revenue growth
Parts and service profitability
Dealer service absorption
Customer satisfaction and retention
Equipment uptime and availability
Dealer parts and service penetration
Technician productivity and capability
Dealer training and certification participation
Resolution time for escalated customer and technical concerns
Forecast accuracy
Warranty and repeat-repair trends
Team engagement, development, and retention
Completion and effectiveness of dealer performance improvement plans

Minimum Qualifications

Ability and willingness to travel up to 50 percent.
Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, construction equipment technology, operations, or a related field preferred.
A minimum of eight years of progressive technical service or product support experience within the construction equipment, heavy equipment, agricultural equipment, material handling, commercial vehicle, or related industry.
A minimum of five years of leadership experience in parts, service, product support, dealer development, or customer support.
Demonstrated experience leading teams and managing performance across multiple locations or a broad geographic territory.
Experience managing parts and service business performance, including revenue, profitability, forecasting, and operational metrics.
Experience working with an independent dealer network or distribution-based business model strongly preferred.
An equivalent combination of education, technical expertise, leadership experience, and industry knowledge may be considered.
Must pass any drug screens, background checks, and any pre-employment tests, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable law.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities & Competencies

Demonstrated success developing and executing customer and product support strategies.
Strong commercial understanding of parts, service, warranty, dealer operations, and equipment lifecycle support.
Proven ability to achieve revenue, profitability, customer satisfaction, and operational performance targets.
Strong working knowledge of profit and loss management, return on investment, absorption rates, forecasting, budgeting, and business performance metrics.
Demonstrated ability to identify business development opportunities and convert them into measurable results.
Strong leadership skills with the ability to set direction, establish accountability, and motivate teams.
Ability to influence dealer owners, senior leaders, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to interpret performance data and develop effective action plans.
Excellent written, verbal, presentation, negotiation, and active-listening skills.
Ability to manage complex customer situations with sound judgment, professionalism, urgency, and diplomacy.
Strong relationship-building skills with a high degree of integrity, credibility, and trust.
Working knowledge of construction equipment applications, diagnostics, service operations, parts distribution, and dealer support.
